# raydom

> A retained-mode UI tree for raylib, in C23 with a C++20 layer: flexbox and grid layout, CSS-like styles, text, input and drawing.

Each page below is Markdown. `llms-full.txt` is the whole book in one file. Read `agents.md` first.

## Start here

- [Introduction](introduction.md): What raydom is and the context/node/style/frame-loop model.
- [For AI agents](agents.md): Rules for generating correct raydom code, and where the machine-readable docs are.

## Getting started

- [Installation](getting-started/installation.md): CMake FetchContent and find_package setup, build options, headers.
- [Quickstart](getting-started/quickstart.md): Complete C and C++ programs that open a window and show styled, clickable text.
- [The frame loop](getting-started/frame-loop.md): What rd_update and rd_draw do each frame; driving input and layout without raylib.

## Guide

- [Nodes and the tree](guide/tree.md): Creating, moving, walking and destroying nodes; generational handles; userdata.
- [Styles and classes](guide/styles.md): Inline styles, classes, state variants, precedence order, inheritance, computed styles.
- [Layout](guide/layout.md): Flexbox and grid, geometry queries, absolute positioning, scrolling, custom measurement.
- [Text and fonts](guide/text.md): Fonts, text nodes, wrapping, ellipsis, line clamping, highlights, measuring, selection.
- [Images](guide/images.md): Loading images from files, memory or pixels; image nodes, aspect-ratio sizing, object_fit, updates.
- [Events](guide/events.md): Listeners, capture and bubble, event types and fields, pointer capture, default actions.
- [Focus, keyboard and text input](guide/input.md): Focus and Tab order, keyboard events, text inputs and their editing keys, clipboard.
- [Roles](guide/roles.md): Semantic roles and the button/text/input constructors; how roles affect focus.
- [Animation](guide/animation.md): Transitions on style changes, layout properties and auto height included; explicit rd_node_animate.
- [Overlay and anchoring](guide/overlay.md): The overlay layer for popups, and anchoring nodes to other nodes or points with flip and shift.
- [Canvases](guide/canvas.md): Custom raylib drawing inside a node with paint callbacks, and the pixel ratio for sharp rendering on the web.

## C++

- [The C++ layer](cpp/overview.md): The rd:: C++ wrapper: ownership, Style builder, literals, callable listeners.

## Extras

- [Controls and toasts](extras/controls.md): Checkbox, switch, radio group, slider and toast components; their events, keys and theme classes.
- [Menus, selects, modals and tooltips](extras/popups.md): Menus, context menus, selects, modal dialogs and tooltips; dismissal and focus rules.
- [Tabs, splitters, lists, tables, trees and breadcrumbs](extras/views.md): Tabs, splitters, virtualized lists, tables, tree views and breadcrumbs; selection, keys, fill callbacks.
- [Network view](extras/graph.md): rdx_graph network view: nodes, edges, messages, pan/zoom, graph events.
- [File dialogs](extras/dialog.md): Native open, save and folder dialogs: rdx_dialog_* in C, rdx::open_file and friends in C++.

## Router

- [Router](router/router.md): raydom::router: path patterns, history, nested routers, links, page lifetime, transitions, trails.

## Reference

- [Style properties](reference/properties.md): Every rd_style property with type, default, inheritance and enum values.
- [Values and units](reference/values.md): rd_val units, colors, edges, corners, shadows, grid tracks and lines.
- [Limits](reference/limits.md): Features raydom does not implement in this version.

## Optional

- [Versioning](versioning.md): Semver policy, per-tag documentation paths, version macros.
